title: Realism catalog file
description: One file of config/break_escape/realism_catalog/. Read by scripts/validate_realism_catalog.rb and, for the shape only, by lib/break_escape/realism_catalog.rb. Entries carry display text for the network view's command-line look: no kind (a scenario decides weakness or decoy), no address, option or banner.

entries.description: A map from catalog id to entry. Ids are append-only once they are in docs/REALISM_CATALOG_INDEX.md.

module.description: The framework console's module path. Unique across the catalog; the first segment is checked by the validator.

output.description: What a scanner reports: the state, a one-line description and a disclosure date. Never a step, a request form or a trigger.
